study.question: Can auxiliary tasks jointly update category/brand values while other item/action values stay private, preserving strong auxiliary predictions and avoiding the primary-task deterioration observed with globally shared values and late tower transfer?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g3-r0005-private_aux_items obtains click AUC 0.6601638278 and auxiliary AUCs 0.8484901/0.8659023/0.8686655, versus tied_joint_items click 0.6583355808; tied_primary_items nearly matches its click score but has weak auxiliary AUCs 0.6798218/0.7235778/0.6626199. Fixed auxiliary tables give the click incumbent 0.6604035937 while auxiliary prediction deteriorates. Earlier item-gradient attenuation (g3-r0004-item_grad_010 and item_grad_050) and whole-auxiliary loss attenuation (aux_loss_010) stayed below item-primary click AUC. In r0006, learned_aux_transfer click AUC 0.6592574965 exceeds learned_self_transfer 0.6588211471 but both lose to their no-residual learned-private parent; fixed_aux_transfer 0.6598360848 loses to fixed_self_transfer 0.6600419281 and both lose to their fixed no-residual parent. Thus donor identity interacts with donor learning, but there is no net successful residual transfer. These are successful executions with negative/null scientific outcomes, not failed runs. Provisional mechanism: uniform item-field sharing obscures field-dependent task compatibility. Because auxiliary labels concern category/brand rather than specific-ad conversion, joint updates restricted to cate_id/brand may transfer useful coarse preferences while private item/campaign/customer/price/action representations contain interference. Field-specific gradients, semantic causality and seed stability have not been observed; this hypothesis is not established by the label definition.

nearest_work.difference: STEM method and section 5.3 were read directly: shared/task-specific tables, stop-gradient expert transfer, and selected-field task embeddings already exist. This proposal tests two field groups on target/history values under one click-owned selector, with one auxiliary-group copy and a 2x2 ownership replacement suite. It has no STEM expert gates or separate copy per auxiliary task. This is not a novelty or reproduction claim. Registry lookup paper:stem failed because it is unregistered; the primary URL was read directly, not presented as a registry source.

Authorized primary text read through tools.py and baseline_reference.py inspected. Inherits target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and Dice; adapts to four fixed labels with task score rows. New intervention concerns field ownership, not a new sequence-attention mechanism or exact original DIN reproduction.

Primary methodology inspected: proxy-mediated heterogeneous interactions and within-type refinement with task tokens. This suite uses direct field-table ownership and a fixed selector, without proxies, iterative token interaction or early task tokens. INFNet effectiveness is not assessed locally.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-169 inspected at git 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, SHA e3750a73af1ceb6b2be4bf9355b70a9ad356985a3c465ef27238ef7e0f28fb4c. It initializes task sequence hubs from multi-task masks and predicts from interacted task tokens; no code is adopted. Benchmark code and original paper are distinct evidence.

inherited_components: All primary-path, shared-context, task score/readout and tower modules from the provided candidate.py (the fixed-table incumbent source) with private-table learning enabled as in g3-r0005-private_aux_items.
Deep-copied item/action tables and feature encoders after full inherited initialization; no checkpoint reuse and no reset after copying.
Original item fields, feature-map order, target/history positions, historical action values and before/after-selector masking; auxiliary rows train through detached selector hidden values.
Default sum of four unweighted BCE losses; frozen host training and scoring. No components of the r0006 residual map are retained.
study.proposed_difference: Implement share_label_fields and share_other_fields switches. Group S is exactly cate_id and brand, matching the auxiliary label keys supplied in the task contract; group R is every other item field plus historical action (expected item_id, campaign_id, customer_id, price_bucket, action). For each group, shared=True feeds primary embeddings without detach to auxiliary target/history pooling, permitting joint updates. shared=False feeds the learned auxiliary copies. Selectors always use the original primary input geometry and receive only click trunk gradients; context remains jointly trained. Four cells: label_fields_shared=(S1,R0), private_fields_control=(S0,R0), other_fields_shared=(S0,R1), all_fields_shared=(S1,R1). Table lookups, dimensions and initialization match. All-private reproduces the successful learned-private parent, while all-shared is a capacity-allocated reproduction of tied_joint_items. No labels enter forward; target action is never used. Reject missing label fields or embedding aliases crossing ownership groups rather than silently changing the data contract.
predictions: Reproduction gate: private_fields_control should reproduce g3-r0005-private_aux_items across all four AUC/Logloss values within 1e-6 under the same host/library setup. all_fields_shared should reproduce g3-r0005-tied_joint_items within 1e-4 click AUC, 1e-3 each auxiliary AUC, and 1e-4 each Logloss, allowing the already observed small accumulation-order sensitivity in equivalent joint-gradient controls. These are prospective engineering tolerances, not significance thresholds. A gate failure pauses archived-endpoint attribution and requires host/source investigation; within-suite contrasts can be reported descriptively with the discrepancy.

Directional policy prediction: AUC(S1,R0) exceeds AUC(S0,R0), AUC(S0,R1) and AUC(S1,R1). A useful candidate should also be compared to the fixed-table click incumbent 0.6604035937; a gain over the learned-private parent alone is not an incumbent gain.

At R=0, the S sharing effect is positive; at S=0, the R sharing effect is negative or smaller. Report both conditional sharing effects and the interaction [AUC11-AUC01]-[AUC10-AUC00], without requiring a particular interaction sign. Report all four task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately from click selection.

The intended joint-quality result retains each auxiliary AUC within 0.005 absolute of the learned-private parent. This tolerance is a secondary predeclared tradeoff descriptor, not a change to the click-AUC selection rule. A click gain with worse auxiliary quality does not establish the claimed joint benefit.

Allocated parameters should remain 56,349,544 (56,054,432 embedding and 295,112 dense) in each cell, subject to host count verification. Active capacity and cost may differ. Compare matched data passes and measured training/validation wall time, GPU allocation, memory, throughput and latency, and avoid equal-compute claims without actual matched measurements.

Inspect inherited validation history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 as secondary comparisons with counts and positive/negative support. Do not invent unavailable field-frequency/gradient/other slices, claim significance from these overlapping users, or reinterpret exploratory slices as confirmatory mechanisms.

Before training/scoring, the authorized host should use separate per-task losses to verify that auxiliary losses update shared selected primary field tables and unshared private tables, while leaving unselected primary tables, unused private copies and score_trunk without auxiliary gradients; click loss must not update private tables. Verify nonzero finite gradients where the batch supplies signal, and output invariance to legal masked-history-ID/target-action perturbations including all-empty histories. No synthetic measurements are claimed in this proposal.
falsifiers: If label_fields_shared does not improve click AUC over private_fields_control, the proposed implementation has not demonstrated useful positive transfer even if it beats globally shared values.
If other_fields_shared performs as well or better, the proposed category/brand preference is unsupported; an arbitrary partial-sharing or effective-capacity explanation remains viable.
If all_fields_shared matches or beats label_fields_shared, excluding the other fields is not justified by this suite; do not claim harmful other-field sharing.
If auxiliary losses/accuracy deteriorate beyond the declared secondary tolerance, the intended preservation of auxiliary quality fails even if click ranking improves.
Failure to reproduce endpoints, finite outputs, per-task gradients or masking invalidates intended attribution until resolved. No dynamic checks have been run here because torch is absent.

Even the predicted ordering from one seed cannot establish semantic causality, gradient conflict or a broadly superior unified architecture. Alternative matched field groupings and paired repetitions may falsify that interpretation.
alternative_explanations: Sharing replaces a learned private value with a jointly updated primary value: forward geometry and gradient ownership change together, so this is an ownership-policy test, not a gradient-only intervention.

Groups differ in cardinality, exposure frequency, size and label relevance; no capacity/cardinality matched alternative grouping is included. Do not attribute a winning group specifically to label semantics.
Allocated capacity is matched, but used embedding capacity, backward work, optimizer state and measured cost may differ.
Shared context updates and the primary-derived selector create indirect coupling; primary-only selector ownership does not imply complete task isolation.
Only the frozen training seed is authorized in this suite; no user-cluster bootstrap predictions or gradient diagnostics are supplied in the coding phase. Single-seed outcomes are preliminary.
Observed tradeoffs may reflect sparse Adagrad learning dynamics, one-pass optimization, gradient clipping of dense parameters only, or Dice running statistics rather than incompatible task semantics.
Shared context can propagate auxiliary changes indirectly even with item tables partitioned; auxiliary selector readout rows still use click-derived hidden geometry.
The official offline history can expose feedback not mature at serving time; the benchmark label semantics and publisher whole-window filtering/static snapshots do not establish production causality.
Primary sources show shared/private and field-selective embeddings are established techniques; this is a local controlled application, and originality remains unverified.
